name: Mac Look
description: Finishing touches for a macOS Tahoe look on GNOME 46: a lock screen with the date above a large clock and the password field at the bottom, the focused app's name in the top bar, the battery at the far right, a Control Center, dock and top bar styled like macOS, a five-finger pinch for the app grid, and Super+` to step back in the Super+Tab app switcher.
